name: tiktok-shop-videopilot
description: AIGC ecommerce product video generation MVP for TikTok Shop sellers.

scripts.ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm stylelint && pnpm lint && pnpm prisma:validate && pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.ark:smoke: pnpm --filter @videopilot/shared build && pnpm --filter @videopilot/ai build && node scripts/ark-smoke.mjs
scripts.demo:ark-video: pnpm --filter @videopilot/shared build && pnpm --filter @videopilot/ai build && pnpm --filter @videopilot/video build && node scripts/render-ark-video-demo.mjs
scripts.demo:fallback-videos: pnpm --filter @videopilot/shared build && pnpm --filter @videopilot/ai build && pnpm --filter @videopilot/video build && node scripts/render-commerce-demos.mjs
